facts.statement: Sanjuansaurus was named and described in 2010 by Oscar Alcober and Ricardo Martinez.
facts.quote: Sanjuansaurus was named and described in 2010 by Oscar Alcober and Ricardo Martinez.

facts.statement: The holotype skeleton of Sanjuansaurus was discovered in 1994 in Ischigualasto Provincial Park, San Juan, Argentina.
facts.quote: PVSJ 605 was discovered in 1994, in gray-green sandstone 40 meters above the base of the Ischigualasto Formation, in Ischigualasto Provincial Park in San Juan, Argentina.

facts.statement: Fossil evidence dates Sanjuansaurus to approximately 231.4 million years ago during the late Carnian Stage.
facts.quote: An ash bed from the early part of the formation dates to approximately 231.4 Ma, during the late Carnian Stage of the Late Triassic.

facts.statement: Sanjuansaurus was about the size of a medium Herrerasaurus, with a femur 395 mm long and a tibia 360 mm long.
facts.quote: Sanjuansaurus was comparable in size to a medium-sized Herrerasaurus, with a thigh bone that was 395 mm long and a tibia that is 360 mm in length (in the description paper the tibia is listed with 260 mm in length due to a typo).

facts.statement: The pubis of Sanjuansaurus points toward the cranium, unlike in other herrerasaurids.
facts.quote: The pubis of Sanjuansaurus, unlike in other herrerasaurids, points toward the cranium.

facts.statement: The pubis of Sanjuansaurus is relatively short, measuring 63% of the femur length, and has a pronounced rugose scar on the medial surface of the femur at the fourth trochanter.
facts.quote: the pubis is relatively short, measuring 63% of the length of the femur a pronounced, rugose scar is present on the medial surface of the femur at the level of the fourth trochanter

facts.statement: Phylogenetic analysis classifies Sanjuansaurus as a herrerasaurid dinosaur.
facts.quote: Alcober and Martinez performed a phylogenetic analysis and found Sanjuansaurus to be a herrerasaurid.

facts.statement: Sanjuansaurus has shelf-like transverse processes on cervical vertebrae, acute anterior and posterior processes on the sixth to eighth dorsal neural spines, and everted lateral margins on the glenoid.
facts.quote: the cervical vertebrae have shelf-like, posterolaterally directed transverse processes the neural spines of the sixth to eighth dorsal vertebrae, at least, bear acute anterior and posterior processes the glenoid has everted lateral margins

facts.statement: Sanjuansaurus lived in South America approximately 231 million years ago during the Carnian stage of the Middle Triassic.
facts.quote: que vivió a mediados del período Triásico, hace aproximadamente 231 millones de años, en el Carniense, en lo que hoy es Sudamérica.

facts.statement: Sanjuansaurus was discovered in 1994 by paleontologist Ricardo N. Martínez.
facts.quote: Sanjuansaurus fue descubierto en 1994 por el paleontólogo de la Universidad Nacional de San Juan Ricardo N. Martínez.

facts.statement: The species S. gordilloi was named in honor of Raúl Gordillo, the main fossil preparator and artist at the San Juan Museum.
facts.quote: La especie tipo fue nombrada S. gordilloi en honor a Raúl Gordillo, el principal preparador de fósiles y artista del Museo de San Juan.

facts.statement: The horizon containing Sanjuansaurus dates to approximately 231.4 million years ago, at the end of the Ladinian during the Middle Triassic.
facts.quote: Este horizonte se remonta a aproximadamente 231,4 millones de años atrás, a finales del Ladiniense durante el Triásico medio.

facts.statement: The holotype specimen of Sanjuansaurus, PVSJ 605, was discovered in 1994.
facts.quote: El espécimen del holotipo Sanjuansaurus, PVSJ 605, fue descubierto en 1994

facts.statement: Sanjuansaurus lived approximately 231.4 million years ago during the late Carnian stage of the Late Triassic.
facts.quote: Este horizonte se remonta a aproximadamente 231,4 millones de años, durante la Etapa Carniana tardía del Triásico Tardío

facts.statement: Sanjuansaurus lived in the Late Triassic jungles of South America.
facts.quote: Sanjuansaurus vivió en las selvas del Triásico Tardío de América del Sur

facts.statement: Sanjuansaurus lived alongside early dinosaurs such as Eoraptor, Herrerasaurus, Chromogisaurus, and Panphagia.
facts.quote: Sanjuansaurus vivió en las selvas del Triásico Tardío de América del Sur junto a los primeros dinosaurios, Eoraptor, Herrerasaurus, Chromogisaurus y Panphagia

facts.statement: The paleoenvironment of the Ischigualasto Formation was a volcanically active alluvial plain covered by forests and subject to heavy seasonal rains.
facts.quote: El paleoambiente de la Formación Ischigualasto era una llanura aluvial volcánicamente activa cubierta por bosques y sujeta a fuertes lluvias estacionales

facts.statement: Sanjuansaurus belongs to the parent group Herrerasauridae.
facts.quote: Parent group: Herrerasauridae

facts.statement: Sanjuansaurus is classified in the family Herrerasauridae.
facts.quote: Family: Herrerasauridae

facts.statement: Sanjuansaurus is classified in the class Saurischia.
facts.quote: Class: Saurischia

facts.statement: The time range for Sanjuansaurus is from 237 to 227.3 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Carnian to Carnian (237 to 227.3 million years ago)
